en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.412 - Abu Al-Hasan the third, Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi (as), was asked about garments made in Basra similar to Yemeni fabric, made of silk (قز) and cotton (قطن), and whether they are suitable for shrouding the deceased.
Imam (as) said: "If the cotton content is greater than the silk, then there is no issue (in using them)."
